minutes.headline: ZBA granted all four special permits, including a house and a two-family in the village center district.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard four special permit applications. It granted a garage side-yard setback exception, a single-family house at 31 School Street, a two-family with a dimensional variation at 944 Mass Ave, and a driveway slope variation at 406 Lancaster Ave. Conditions were attached to the sewer connection and the driveway repair.

votes.motion: Grant special permit for a ten-foot side-yard exception at the back corner of the garage at 15 Woodland Drive.
Approve special permit in the village center district for a single-family home at 31 School Street.
Grant special permit for two-family use in the village center district and a dimensional special permit at 944 Mass Ave, with condition of sewer connection and decommissioning the old septic system.
Grant dimensional special permit for driveway slope at 406 Lancaster Ave, conditioned on the driveway being suitable for emergency and commercial use before building the house.

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant's representative said money had already been spent on engineering for the lot.

budget_items.topic: Driveway repair cost at 406 Lancaster Ave
budget_items.what_was_said: An applicant described a paving estimate and a possible cost share with the neighbor who owns the driveway.

decisions.decision: Board agreed to condition the 944 Mass Ave permit on connecting to municipal sewer and properly closing out the old septic system.
Board agreed to condition the Lancaster Ave permit on the driveway being suitable for emergency and commercial access before the house is built.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for two-family use and a dimensional variation at 944 Mass Ave, with sewer and septic conditions.
The board approved a village center special permit for a single-family house at 31 School Street.
The board granted a dimensional permit for driveway slope at 406 Lancaster Ave, conditioned on emergency and commercial access before the house is built; the vote was not audible.
The board granted a side-yard setback exception for the garage at 15 Woodland Drive.

why_it_matters: The permits add a house and a two-family home in the village center, and abutters raised drainage, noise and notice concerns at the 31 School Street hearing.
The sewer and driveway conditions set what the owners must build before or alongside the projects, and the Lancaster Ave driveway repair may be a cost shared with a neighbor.
